title: Penny Squirrel's Big Acorn
description: A charming story of a little squirrel who learns that big tasks are easier when shared with friends.

scenes.narration: Penny the squirrel loved collecting crunchy treats for autumn, rustling through the golden fall leaves.
scenes.visual: fluffy orange squirrel leaping happily through bright yellow and red fallen leaves

scenes.narration: Under a giant oak tree, she discovered the biggest, shiny acorn she had ever seen in her life.
scenes.visual: little squirrel standing in front of an enormous golden oak acorn

scenes.narration: Penny tried to lift it, but it was far too heavy for one small squirrel to roll up the grassy hill.
scenes.visual: squirrel pushing against a massive acorn with all her strength on a grassy slope

scenes.narration: Instead of giving up, Penny called her brother Sammy. Together, they pushed the acorn side by side.
scenes.visual: two cute squirrels pushing a giant acorn up a soft grassy hill together

scenes.narration: With four busy paws working together, the giant acorn rolled smoothly all the way to their cozy tree trunk.
scenes.visual: two happy squirrels resting together next to their big acorn inside a cozy tree cavity

scenes.narration: They shared a delicious feast and cheered. Working together makes every big heavy job feel light.
scenes.visual: two squirrels smiling and sharing small acorn pieces together in a warm room

scenes.narration: Good friends make every burden small. Close your eyes, and follow along for more comforting tales.
scenes.visual: two little squirrels sleeping soundly side by side wrapped in a soft leafy blanket

character_reference: A small, fluffy reddish-brown squirrel with a pale cream-colored belly, a prominent bushy tail, and a small dark green neckerchief.
